outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain/epitope schematic plus representative western blots demonstrating IP efficiency; no quantification or statistics are shown in this panel, so replicate reporting is not required.

Panel B presents quantified bar-chart data (% HTT FT depletion and log2 elution abundance vs. mIgG for each antibody) but the caption gives no indication of how many times the western blot/densitometry measurement was replicated or what kind of replicate (biological, technical) underlies each bar.

replicate_statements: Raw MS protein abundances were normalized by their respective replicate medians and theoretical number of tryptic peptides and expressed as the log2 average of two biological replicates in Q20 and Q140-8 weeks conditions.
outputs.explanation: The heatmap shows values averaged (a summary statistic) from only n = 2 biological replicates; although both the number and type of replicate are reported, n = 2 is too low to support the summary averaging shown, so the panel fails the replication-adequacy criterion.

The violin plots summarize enrichment-ratio distributions across proteins/experiments but the caption does not state how many replicate experiments or samples underlie the plotted distributions, nor their type.

An n-number (n = 4) and summary statistic (mean ± SD) are given, but the caption does not specify what the 4 replicates represent (e.g., independent IP experiments, biological replicates, or individual animals), so the replicate type is not reported.
Panel F is a sequence alignment and a single predicted (AlphaFold) structural model, a non-quantitative representative depiction that does not involve replicated experimental measurements.
The scatterplots compare log2 enrichment ratios across conditions but the caption does not state the number or type of replicate experiments used to derive these values.

replicate_statements: showing high correlation in all individual IP-MS experiments by tissue
outputs.explanation: The caption identifies that each point represents an individual IP-MS experiment (replicate type given), but does not state how many such experiments/replicates were performed.

The PCA plot aggregates many individual data points (presumably replicate experiments/samples) stratified by antibody set and tissue, but neither the number nor type of underlying replicates is stated in the caption.
As in panel I, this PCA analysis presents multiple data points per condition without the caption specifying the number or type of replicates represented.
